## Prism 19 - Error Logger & Health
Wire as the Error Workflow on every Prism workflow (Settings > Error Workflow). Captures workflow/execution/failed-node details and persists them to agent_audit_logs (action=workflow.error) so any failure is queryable by requestId. Set PRISM_SUPABASE_URL as an instance environment variable; falls back to a logged no-op until configured.
